shots.say: How to check if your certifications are current, in one minute.
shots.caption: Are your certifications current?

shots.say: Open More, then Training, then My Training.
shots.caption: More → Training → My Training

shots.say: Open Certifications. Green means current. Yellow means it expires soon, so renew it. Red means it has expired. Talk to your training officer.
shots.caption: Green current · Yellow expiring · Red expired

shots.say: Every certification shows its expiration date, and anything due in the next six months is listed at the top.
shots.caption: Due in the next 6 months? It's listed at the top

shots.say: Took a class somewhere else? Tap the Submit Training button to send it in for credit.
shots.caption: Took a class elsewhere? Submit Training

shots.say: Stay ahead of your certs. Your career depends on it.
shots.caption: Stay ahead of your certs
